description: 57 retrieval cases over the pinned 23-record MITRE subset (CWE 4.20 and CAPEC 3.9). Scored cases have relevant source documents; behaviour cases have none and only check how a retriever handles thin or out-of-corpus queries. A SMALL, MANUALLY CURATED benchmark: not an unbiased or comprehensive relevance assessment, and not evidence of general retrieval quality.
protocol: Version 1 (22 cases, unchanged on disk) is carried forward as the DEVELOPMENT set because its results had already been observed; labels of carried cases are copied verbatim. All new cases were written by the implementing AI assistant after reading the corpus and BEFORE any retrieval was run on them, and were assigned to a development or heldout split when written. Retrieval changes may be tuned only on development cases; heldout cases are run once after the retrieval implementation is frozen. The author knew both sets, so the split limits tuning leakage but does not make the benchmark blind. Labels follow data/retrieval_benchmark/ANNOTATION_GUIDE_v2.md. Review status of each label set is in label_provenance; no human reviewer has been involved. Questions never contain identifiers except in category identifier_lookup, where every identifier must name a labelled record.

splits.development: May be used to tune the retriever. Includes all 22 cases carried from v1.
splits.heldout: Run only after the retrieval implementation is frozen; never used for tuning.

review_summary.note: Pass 1 was a blind AI review (same model family as the author, separate context, truncated corpus digest). It is not an independent human annotation. Disagreements were adjudicated by the author under the amendments in the annotation guide and are flagged for human re-adjudication. Pass 1 was completed before any retrieval was run on v2.
